title_i18n.zh: OpenAI 详解 GPT-Live 架构如何实现了连续的有状态语音交互
title_i18n.en: OpenAI details how the GPT-Live architecture enables continuous, stateful voice interaction.
title_i18n.es: OpenAI detalla cómo la arquitectura GPT-Live permite una interacción de voz continua y con estado.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 最近，OpenAI 发布了一篇关于 GPT-Live 的工程报告。该报告详细描述了他们如何设计这个系统，将对延迟敏感的媒体处理与更广泛的应用工作分离，同时保持语音交互的连续性。

excerpt_i18n.zh: 推理模型持续突破能力边界，Coding Agent 深度参与研发流程，Agent Runtime、Agent Framework 快速演进……AI 正在从回答问题的模型，演变为能够自主规划、调用工具、执行任务的软件系统。AI 不再只是软件中的一个能力，而开始成为软件系统的一部分。这意味着软件工程面对的挑战也发生了变化：团队需要思考的不再只是如何训练模型、模型、部署模型 或优化 Prompt，而不是如何让具备自主能力的 AI 稳定、可信、可控地运行。 模型决定 AI 能做什么，系统决定 AI 能否真正创造价值。
excerpt_i18n.en: Reasoning models continue to break through capability boundaries, Coding Agents are deeply involved in the R&D process, and Agent Runtime and Agent Framework are evolving rapidly... AI is transforming from a model that answers questions into a software system that can autonomously plan, call tools, and execute tasks. AI is no longer just a capability within software—it is becoming part of the software system itself. This means the challenges faced by software engineering have also shifted: teams no longer need to think only about how to train models, deploy models, or optimize prompts, but rather how to make autonomous AI run stably, reliably, and controllably. Models determine what AI can do; systems determine whether AI can truly create value.
excerpt_i18n.es: Los modelos de razonamiento continúan superando los límites de sus capacidades, los Coding Agents participan profundamente en los procesos de desarrollo, Agent Runtime y Agent Framework evolucionan rápidamente… La IA está pasando de ser un modelo que responde preguntas a convertirse en un sistema de software capaz de planificar de forma autónoma, invocar herramientas y ejecutar tareas. La IA ya no es solo una capacidad dentro del software, sino que comienza a formar parte de los sistemas de software. Esto significa que los desafíos a los que se enfrenta la ingeniería de software también han cambiado: los equipos ya no necesitan pensar únicamente en cómo entrenar modelos, implementar modelos u optimizar prompts, sino en cómo lograr que la IA con capacidades autónomas sea estable y fiable.

title_i18n.en: Anyone else feeling uneasy with the latest developments in AI?
title_i18n.zh: 最近AI的发展让其他人也感到不安吗？
title_i18n.es: ¿Alguien más se siente intranquilo con los últimos avances en IA?

excerpt_i18n.en: I'm feeling extremely depressed and anxious lately. After seeing Astra saturating ARC-AGI-3 and blowing through many other benchmarks, it's hard to believe we won't have a strong form of AGI by the end of this year, or the next one at the latest. I don't understand why we're not seeing a MASSIVE clamor for a pause in the further development of AI strength. Even if we don't know how to coordinate and enforce such a pause yet (at the multi-nation level), it seems we're not spending any effort in figuring how to. I see a lot of people dismissing warnings from the frontier companies themselves as nothing but "marketing and generating hype". items.title: Denzel Explains AI "Slop"
items.raw_excerpt: This is a Reddit post from r/ClaudeCode where user Denzel explains AI 'slop,' a term referring to low-quality, mass-generated AI content, possibly in the context of Claude Code.

title_i18n.en: Denzel Explains AI "Slop"
title_i18n.zh: 丹泽尔解释AI“垃圾内容”

excerpt_i18n.en: This is a Reddit post from r/ClaudeCode where user Denzel explains AI 'slop,' a term referring to low-quality, mass-generated AI content, possibly in the context of Claude Code.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该文章是 Reddit 上 r/ClaudeCode 板块的一个帖子，用户 Denzel 对 AI "Slop" 这一概念进行了解释。"Slop" 通常指由 AI 生成的大量低质量、缺乏真实价值或语无伦次的内容，Denzel 可能结合 Claude Code 的使用情境来阐述其含义及影响。
